newsitem.title: USA: Vulcan Materials sees Q4 drop in one segment.
newsitem.headline: Vulcan Materials sees Q4 drop in one segment.

text.p: Vulcan Materials Co said Monday it expects earnings for its construction materials segment will be "down somewhat" in the fourth quarter over the previous year because of lower gains from land sales.
The company said gains from land sales in the past year's fourth quarter were "especially large."
Nevertheless, it said it expected that segment's earnings for the full year will probably exceed its 1995 levels.
However, the company said it expects an improved performance of its chemical segment's performance systems business unit in the fourth quarter and for the year.
The unit has been benefiting from improved earnings contributions from both Callaway Chemical and Vulcan Chemical Technologies, the company said.

"Our current view is that the fourth quarter 1996 net earnings and earnings per share for the company may fall modestly short of comparable 1995 results, which were at record levels," Chairman and Chief Executive H.A. Sklenar said in a statement. "Nonetheless, for the full year, the company's net earnings and earnings per share should be at record levels."
In the 1995 fiscal year, the company posted net income of $166.2 million, or $4.63 per share, on revenues of $416.3 million.
